title: MEMS-1K benchmark file
description: Multi-Entity Multi-Shot 1K. 1,000 three-shot narrative scenarios over 7 patterns. Each scenario prescribes exactly which entities must be on screen in each shot (S*) and therefore which entrances/exits must occur between shots (delta S*).

version.description: Benchmark version, e.g. '1.0.0'. Bump on any change to prompts or matrices.

num_shots.description: T. Every MEMS-1K video is one mp4 holding T equal-length shots in order.

patterns.description: The 7 canonical narrative patterns. Relay and Split are the algebraic basis (Theorem 3.1); the other five are derived.

presenceMatrix.description: S*, shape T x N, binary. Row t = shot t+1 (top row is the first shot). Column j = entities[j]; column order is ALWAYS the entity_id order A, B, C. S*[t][j] = 1 means entity j must be visible in shot t+1.

transitionMatrix.description: delta S* = S*[1:] - S*[:-1], shape (T-1) x N, values in {-1, 0, +1}. Row t is the transition from shot t+1 to shot t+2. +1 = prescribed entrance, -1 = prescribed exit, 0 = no change prescribed. PTM is scored ONLY on the non-zero cells; the zero cells contribute to EPA and to Type III (spurious) failures but never to PTM.

entity_id.description: Role label. Its position in the sorted id order (A, B, C) is the matrix column index.

name.description: Noun phrase as it appears in the generation prompts, e.g. 'toddler'.

eval_name.description: String substituted into the detector query 'Is there a {eval_name} visible in this image? Answer only Yes or No.' Identical to `name` in MEMS-1K v1.0; kept separate so a detector may use different wording without changing the generation prompts.

entity_type.description: Coarse category tag from dataset construction: 'H' generic person, 'P' professional/role-defined person, 'A' animal.

shotPrompts.description: One string per shot, keyed shot_1 .. shot_T.

scenario_id.description: Unique id, also the expected video filename stem: <scenario_id>.mp4

theme.description: Scene/domain tag used to diversify the 1,000 scenarios, e.g. 'Domestic_LivingRoom'.

shot_structure.description: Human-readable rendering of S*, e.g. ['A', 'AB', 'B']. Derived from presence_matrix; '-' denotes an empty shot.

gen_prompt.description: Prompt fed to the video generator for each shot. Equals eval_prompt + generation_settings.positive_suffix.

eval_prompt.description: Bare shot description without style suffix. NOT the detector query -- the detector asks about entities[j].eval_name, not about this sentence.

diag_prompt.description: Short entity-only phrase used by the CLIP-based baseline metric, e.g. 'a toddler and a mother together'. Not used by STEM.

generation_settings.description: Shared generation controls. Reported for reproducibility; a system that ignores them is still comparable as long as it is stated.

num_active_transitions.description: Count of non-zero cells in transition_matrix = the denominator of PTM for this scenario (2 or 3 in MEMS-1K).
